marketBrief.headline: Afternoon: Stocks close lower after hot October CPI; Nasdaq -0.74%; CoreWeave beats after the bell
marketBrief.summary: The S&P 500 closed at 7,520.93 (-0.38%), the Dow at 52,231.89 (-0.30%) and the Nasdaq Composite at 25,065.87 (-0.74%) after October CPI rose 0.4% against a 0.3% forecast (CNBC; BLS). Nvidia fell more than 5% and chip stocks led the decline. Traders now price a quarter-point December hike, with about 13.6% odds of a half-point move (CNBC).
bullets: Close, Nov. 10: S&P 500 7,520.93 (-0.38%); Dow 52,231.89 (-0.30%); Nasdaq Composite 25,065.87 (-0.74%) (CNBC live updates).
Monday's close: S&P 500 7,549.94, its best day since April by AP's count (recap citing AP).
October CPI: +0.4% m/m vs +0.3% expected; core +0.3% vs +0.2% expected; no 12-month rate published (BLS; CNBC).
Nvidia fell more than 5% on Tuesday after a 4% drop the prior session; semiconductors were the weakest group (Yahoo Finance).
CoreWeave Q3: revenue $3.66B, above its $3.45-$3.60B guide; net interest $846M, below its $860-$940M guide; shares up about 2% after hours (CoreWeave IR; Benzinga).
